Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process; cylinder = stored state. Arrows: caller → recipient, response included; solid
(sync) = awaited request/reply.
Loser gets 0 rows: skipped, edits lost

Each UPDATE autocommits with no isolation
override (Postgres default READ
COMMITTED): a concurrent loser waits on
the row lock, re-checks, gets 0 rows →
skipped; its edits drop, card hides.

Source: lib/engine.ts:1346-1358;
lib/db/client.ts:9-20; components/today.tsx:174-176
Suppression, not exactly-once

Winner resolves only after guards and a
delivery try. Guard fails and in-try throws
reset it to failed (re-sendable), even if
markSent threw after Gmail accepted;
closed/replied → skipped.
Source: lib/engine.ts:1360-1466
A crash after the claim strands the row

A timeout (maxDuration 300) or a query
throw outside the try leaves the row
sending: Send/Skip can't claim it;
email/LinkedIn rows count to the limit for
24h; only LinkedIn gets a 3h alert.
Outside this view: Guards and Gmail/LinkedIn/X delivery after a successful claim; Conversation Send: each click inserts its own row, so no shared claim.
